popupUseWorkerDesc.message: Off: WebTransport connects directly in the page (main-thread CPU; fine at normal report rates). WebSocket still needs the worker.

popupInPageWtWarning.message: In-page WebTransport may trigger a Firefox local-network permission prompt ("wants to access other apps and services on this device"). Tick "Remember my choice for this site" before clicking Allow, otherwise you will be asked again on every page load.

statusOfflineGuidance.message: Check that the daemon is running (systemctl status webhid-daemon), that your user is in the webhid group, and that the udev rules are installed.

macPrivacyDesc.message: Allow the daemon to read HID devices: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. If the link does not open the right tab, find it manually and enable the daemon.

settingsDaemonAsNmHostDesc.message: Talk to the daemon directly over native messaging, skipping the forwarder and Unix socket. Requires the daemon_nm_host manifest and the daemon running as your user (with the udev rule). Lower latency, no root-daemon fallback. Reconnects automatically.

settingsDataPlaneDesc.message:
**WebSocket**: a Web Worker owns the WS connection; input reports are forwarded to the page via postMessage (off main thread).
**WebTransport**: the same worker model over QUIC, or directly in the page when Use Worker is off.
**Native Messaging**: all data (sendReport, input reports, feature reports) goes through the NM host. No WS. Fallback when WS/WT are blocked.

settingsDevicePickerModeDesc.message:
**Modal**: shadow-DOM overlay on the page when requestDevice() is called (default).
**Page Action**: URL-bar popup picker; the user clicks the icon to open it. Firefox only, Chromium falls back to modal.
**Window**: separate popup window.

settingsWorkerPolyfillDesc.message: Inject WebHID API stubs into Worker scripts (new Worker(), new SharedWorker()). Methods throw NotSupportedError until full worker communication is implemented. Reload pages after changing.

settingsAllowActivationlessDesc.message: Skip the user-activation requirement for requestDevice() on this site. Spec deviation; workaround for sites that call it from an async handler. The chooser still requires explicit user selection. Reload pages after changing.

settingsLogLevelDesc.message: Console verbosity: Error = errors only, Warn = +warnings, Info = +info, Debug = +debug (includes timing). Reload pages after changing.

pickerNoMatch.message: No devices match the specified filters

settingsWorkerSpawnModeDesc.message:
**Shadow URL** (default on MV3): spawns the data worker via new Worker(location.href) with a StreamFilter intercepting the synthetic self-request. Fails if the server rejects it or if require-trusted-types-for is restrictive.
**Blob + CSP rewrite** (default on MV2): spawns the worker from a blob: URL; relaxes the page's worker-src and connect-src directives.

settingsUseWorkerDesc.message:
On: the WS/WT data plane runs in a dedicated Web Worker (off main thread, recommended).
Off: WebTransport connects directly in the page (main-thread CPU; fine at normal report rates). Firefox asks a one-time local-network permission ("Allow") for the page before the first in-page WebTransport connection; workers are exempt. WebSocket still needs the worker because HSTS rewrites ws:// to wss:// on pages. Reload pages after changing.
